title: FederatedBytes: Tokenizer-Free, Byte-Level Small Language Models for Efficient Multimodal Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22906v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a powerful machine learning framework that allows building a global model from the contributions of multiple, distributed clients, while ensuring the privacy of their local data. However, its heavy computational and communication overheads challenge its use for contemporary AI workloads such as natural language processing (NLP) and multimodal analysis. For this reason, this paper presents a novel small language model that leverages byte-level text and multimodal data processing, enhanced by a linear attention mechanism, to enable manageable Federated Learning of NLP and multimodal analysis tasks. The proposed model, nicknamed FederatedBytes, manages to process text and any other data types, including images, by treating its input as a mere sequence of bytes, while its lean linear attention mechanism allows abating the overall memory and computational footprint. translated_title: FederatedBytes：无分词器、字节级小型语言模型，用于高效的多模态联邦学习
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）是一种强大的机器学习框架，能够基于多个分布式客户端的贡献构建全局模型，同时保护其本地数据的隐私。然而，其高昂的计算与通信开销限制了它在自然语言处理（NLP）和多模态分析等当代AI工作负载中的应用。为此，本文提出了一种新型小型语言模型，该模型利用字节级的文本和多模态数据处理，并通过线性注意力机制加以增强，从而使NLP和多模态分析任务的联邦学习变得可行。该模型名为FederatedBytes，它将输入视为纯粹的字节序列，因而能够处理文本以及包括图像在内的任何其他数据类型；同时，其精简的线性注意力机制降低了整体的内存与计算开销。为验证所提模型的有效性……
tldr: 提出FederatedBytes——一种无分词器、将所有输入视为字节序列并采用线性注意力机制的小型语言模型，显著降低了NLP与多模态分析任务在联邦学习中的计算和通信开销。
en_tdlr: FederatedBytes is a tokenizer-free, byte-level small language model with linear attention that enables efficient federated learning for NLP and multimodal analysis by drastically reducing computational and communication overhead.
